title: Petition of Colonial Gas Company for approval and authority, in connection with a proposed three-for-two split of its Common Stock, to (i) decrease the par value per share of its Common Stock from $5.00 to $3.33 and (ii) issue not in excess of 2,800,000 shares of Common Stock, $3.33 par value, pursuant to G.L. c. 164, §§ 6, 8, and 14, as amended.
petitioner: Colonial Gas Company d/b/a National Grid
